_about: Tulvo's brand for video, by role. The engine reads this file; scenes never name a colour or a font themselves. Keys that start with an underscore are notes for people and are ignored by the engine. How to use these values is in brand.md. After any edit run: node tools/brand/sync.mjs, then node tools/brand/check.mjs tulvo
name: Tulvo

colours._about: The same seven roles on a light page and a dark page. Tulvo's own colour names are in the notes beside each value.
colours._source: Desktop/Tulvo/DESIGN.md (marketing site design system), the Product Hunt launch kit social style, and the film partners approved during the Black Friday film on 10 Nov 2026

light._about: Pure white, like tulvo.io (owner decision 11 Nov 2026). Warm paper #F5F3EF and its warm line #E4E2DE stay in colours.other for the social style only.
light._second: muted: the second clause of a headline and supporting text
light._warm: warm_peach: old prices, deadlines, one warm note per scene
light._on_accent: paper: text on an action blue button

dark._on_accent: paper: text on a bright blue button

colours._confetti: bright_blue, ice_blue, paper, warm_peach, action_blue, pale_blue

other._about: Tulvo colours with no role in the kit yet, kept so nothing is lost. A scene may not use them by name; give one a role first.

stages._about: How each page is lit when it fills the frame. A light is a soft pool of colour: x and y are shares of the frame (0 is left or top, 1 is right or bottom), radius is a share of frame height, opacity is 0 to 1. Grain and vignette are strengths from 0 to 1. screen_glow is how strongly the accent glows around a product window.

light._about: One soft white light from the upper left, fine grain, no glow.

dark._about: Slow pools of deep blue, navy and bright blue, grain, a vignette. The light comes from the product.

fonts._about: One typeface per voice. Each says where its file comes from: "file" is a file in this brand's fonts/ folder, "package" is a file of an npm package installed in engine/.
_rules: At most three type voices in one frame: headline, the accent, and product UI if a screen is showing.
Never set product UI in Instrument Sans, and never set film type in Inter.
No coding-style (monospaced) typeface anywhere in a film or on the review page. Owner's rule, 11 Nov 2026.
Numbers that change use fixed-width figures of Instrument Sans.

headline._role: Every headline, title and caption in the film

accent._role: One emphasis word in a headline. At most once per line and three times per film
accent._status: approved by the owner 11 Nov 2026; the file comes from the installed package, and the installer confirms the licence

label._role: Small labels, prices, counters and timers. Sentence case, medium weight. Numbers that change use fixed-width figures

product._role: Product UI only. The live app is set in Inter; any rebuilt screen must use it
product._status: the file comes from the installed package

logo._about: Files in logo/. The wordmark opens and closes a film. The mark is the symbol alone.

shape._about: Corner radii as shares of frame height.
shape._source: Marketing site: 12 px controls and panels. Social kit: 16 px app windows.
shape._button: ink fill, white text; action blue on emphasis

captions._about: The caption design is the same for every brand: a dark glass bar with words arriving as they are spoken. Only these values may differ. The typeface is the headline voice.
captions._highlight: bright_blue: the one highlighted phrase in a line

product_ui._about: The product's own colours. Product UI is staged, never restyled. The kit reads only "background"; the rest is for rebuilt screens.
product_ui._source: Live app.tulvo.io light-mode CSS, captured 2026-10-20. Re-capture before relying on it; the product changes.

chip_fills_from_workspace._source: Dropdown option colours returned by the Tulvo connector for the demo workspace

rejected._source: Feedback on the Black Friday storyboards
rejected._note: The social kit's lilac, orchid and blush gradient was rejected for film. Product UI keeps its own purple and pink status chips; the rule applies to stages, type and effects.
patterns: dots used as separators between words

_headline_pattern.two_part: First clause in ink (or white on dark), second clause in the second colour (muted on light, ice blue on dark). 'Same business. One app instead of twelve.'
